title: FULL PRESSER: David Grusch & Lawmakers Call for UAP Records Declassification on Capitol Hill | AC1E
description:
Former intelligence officer and whistleblower David Grusch joined lawmakers on Capitol Hill to call for the declassification of records related to unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAPs).

During the press conference, speakers urged greater transparency regarding historical UAP investigations, classified government records, and congressional oversight. The event also highlighted ongoing efforts to improve public access to information concerning unidentified aerial phenomena and related government programs.

The briefing follows years of growing public and congressional interest in UAP reports, military encounters, and disclosure legislation.

Watch the full press conference, key statements, and reactions as lawmakers and advocates discuss the future of UAP transparency and government accountability.
